claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 323 attendees for this Cultural Fest, in line with turnout at our previous Cultural Fest events.
We can deliver this Cultural Fest efficiently within INR 46,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
